blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each identity with the property it shows.
blocks.display: Match each identity with the property it shows.

blocks.text: Eight times five equals five times eight. The factors swap places, so it is commutative.
The quantity a plus b, plus four, equals a plus the quantity b plus four. Same order, the parentheses moved. Associative.
Seven plus the quantity y plus one equals seven plus the quantity one plus y. The parentheses stay where they are. Inside, y and one swap. Commutative.
x times the quantity three times two equals the quantity x times three, times two. Same order, new grouping. Associative.
Order changes mean commutative. Grouping changes mean associative.
